name: Etherium
description: A rare metal that Tezzeret reshapes into a message and gives to Estel.

timeline.summary: Vronos studies etherium and the Twenty-Three Texts with the Ethersworn, repairs his face with an etherium infix and mask, and learns to planeswalk and track other planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: he honed his planeswalking skill and discovered how to track others like himself by the faint trails they left in the Æther.

timeline.summary: Breya discovers carmot in Jund and replaces most of her body with etherium she created herself.
timeline.quote: To prove her achievement, Breya replaced the majority of her organic body with etherium she created herself.

timeline.summary: Silas Renn rises in the Seekers of Carmot and receives the first etherium heart.
timeline.quote: he was honored with the first etherium heart ever produced

pages_say.description: A mysterious metal tying beings to the sea of energy between planes, used by Vronos for his mask and implants.
An aether-infused alloy that Esper uses to augment living things.
A rare metal that Tezzeret reshapes into a message and gives to Estel.
